name: single_model_initializer_screen_v1
motivation: The first pilot still trails the specialist on independent synthetic ratings; its update L2 is 0.448 versus a 9.017 recommender task delta. Screen stronger common-ancestor initializations using synthetic data only. Weight geometry is not evidence that a merge will work.

definitions.decoder_interpolation: interpolate decoder.* only; keep every other general tensor unchanged
definitions.inference: Materialize exactly one parameter set before inference; never average predictions or route between networks

bank.policy: Fresh synthetic seeds; cache inputs, targets, masks, and scaling once in RAM and use identical cases for all candidates; no real benchmark matrix or labels

selection.metric: Minimum worst ratio across imputation RMSE, ratings user-macro RMSE, and ratings user-macro MAE
selection.imputation_reference: The better of general and same-input observed-blend aggregate synthetic RMSE, fixed before screening candidates
selection.ratings_reference: The frozen specialist on the identical synthetic cases
selection.ties: Earlier registered candidate wins exact ties
selection.scope: Initialization selection only; no benchmark victory or completed training claim
selection.confirmation: Any follow-on trained checkpoint needs a separate, newly seeded synthetic confirmation before another complete real benchmark campaign

execution.reason: Use GPU only after the existing benchmark campaign terminates; campaign scores are not inputs to the screen
execution.storage: Do not save all 13 full checkpoints; save only an eligible selected initialization, plus manifests and every candidate/case score
execution.continue_training: Not automatic; use synthetic evidence to choose initialization and objective before launching another registered continuation
